🎨 Appearance

Switches themes that have both a light and a dark look. Auto follows your device. Themes that only come in one look (like Terminal) stay as they are.

🚨 Panic key

Press the key once and this tab jumps straight to the site. Click the key button to pick a different one (Esc, F-keys, or Ctrl/Alt + a key).

🧩 Layout

The sidebar is off by default. Turn it on to keep your channels, chats and who's online on the left.

💬 People

Who's online (this lives here while the sidebar is off). To message one person privately, reply to their message and tap 🙈 Hidden.
